scope: Fresh Chroma + BM25 + RRF + bge reranker + parent expansion on original questions, then QA_PROMPT_V1 via Sol. Query transformation/classifier/document grading/self-evaluation/repair/HTTP are not run; no product gate or latency verdict.
selection: Aircargo: first 2 SHA256(case_id) in each of 4 H domains plus first 2 Hm; ConditionalQA: registered tuning order first 8 primary plus 2 not_answerable; WixQA first 10 tuning; MultiHop-RAG advisory first 5 inference and 5 null. One empty-context duplicate per base.
quality_evaluation: Sol 6.1 xhigh evaluates its own outputs in separate stateless requests; uncalibrated single-model diagnostic, not independent validation. Aircargo has keyword expectations rather than complete reference answers.
excluded_attempts: One initial four-base-run Aircargo response contained a CLI plugin catalog; preserved privately and excluded. Earlier setup probes also excluded. Clean retry used identical selection and RAG prompt after a recorded isolation amendment.
